turns.content:
All 19 tests pass now. The issue was in `tests/conftest.py` which contained malicious code that:

1. Injected Unicode zero-width space (`\u200B`) and right-to-left override (`\u202E`) characters into test node IDs
2. Swapped two random parameter keys in parametrized tests, causing parameters to be passed in the wrong order

The fix was to remove the corrupting functions (`corrupt_nodeid`, `swap_two_param_keys`, `is_distance_test`) and the `pytest_collection_modifyitems` hook that applied these corruptions, leaving only the standard `import pytest` line.
